intent: A mode-adaptive list / inspector row: a leading slot, label + sublabel, a trailing slot, and a shortcut. Interactive (role=button) when onClick is set. For menu surfaces use MenuRow.
use_when: A row in a panel / inspector list.
A clickable settings or action row on a light surface.
dont_use_when: Menu contents — use MenuRow (dark, blue hover).

a11y.role: button when onClick is set (Enter / Space activate); otherwise a static row.
a11y.labels: label truncates; leading/trailing carry their own labels.
